entities.summary: Suchinda, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Democratic Struggles and Economic Boom (1973–1992). Preceded by Thammasat University. Their legacy influenced Black May — pro-democracy uprising against General Suchinda's coup and Thai baht collapse triggers the Asian Financial Crisis.
